description: The image displays two donut charts side by side, titled "AttentionInfluence" on the left and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" on the right, each illustrating a hierarchical distribution of categories with numerical values. The visual representation uses a color gradient from light blue to dark red, with larger segments corresponding to higher values. The charts are structured such that the outer ring represents the main categories and the inner ring shows the subcategories, with each segment labeled with its name and value. The "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" chart has a legend indicating the color coding for different categories, while the "AttentionInfluence" chart does not. The overall layout suggests a comparison between two different classification systems or models, with the "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" showing a more balanced distribution across categories compared to the "AttentionInfluence" model.
